notes:
- Closest Node tests cap, rail and interior satin markers against actual generated stitches. Satin cover can use a different direction from the underlay when that gives a shorter join.
- Route comparisons prioritize fewer trims and shorter jump distance. Sewn travel breaks ties.
- Optimize Selected Stitch Order checks more same-color sequences while keeping overlap order, and reevaluates the joins after each reorder.
- Drag Start and End independently on editable satin. Opposite-end markers use one cover sweep. A middle exit uses two sweeps when the travel run can stay under the satin.
- Select all, Visibility, and the move-to-top and move-to-bottom buttons stay visible when scrolling Objects & Stitch Order. The four buttons share the same height.
- Downloads and automatic update checks use the RoguePixelLabs GitHub address.
